source: David Tom Foss Hugging Face CPU-performance jobs 6aecff9ec78863f9c633a8f1 and 6aed00160e0338d1bb80bdf4, 2026-11-05

activation_space_product_codes.conclusion: Post-hoc nearest-centroid activation VQ neither generalizes nor produces a profitable temporal transition rate on held-out real states. Static activation reconstruction is the wrong training objective.

consumer_quotient_down_projection.conclusion: Consumer-space state transitions are computationally profitable, but a K=16 post-hoc codebook is far below the required fidelity. The representation must be trained jointly with the upstream gate/up producer so the producer emits quotient codes directly.

positive_result: Consumer quotienting is validated as an execution primitive: once codes exist, down-projection state updates are about 2x faster on the real model. The remaining problem is code formation, now moved into model/codec co-design rather than runtime arithmetic.
